graded_lexicon.name: flelex
graded_lexicon.note: the TreeTagger build of FLELex with one stated level per word and part of speech, aligned on the Beacco reference descriptions for French; read as a profile, so its level is taken outright

noun_gender_note: a graded lexicon gives bare headwords; the wiktionary headword line marks the gender with {{m}} or {{f}}. before a vowel or a mute h the article elides to l', and the article's colour on the card still shows the gender. an aspirated h (le héros) is not told apart
